Container.Name: whatson
Container.Overview: Search what's on Live TV and in your Plex or Jellyfin library, then put it on a TV with one tap. Each TV needs the Plezy app.[br][br]After the first start, open the Web UI, connect your server in Settings → Server and pair your TVs in Settings → TVs. There is no login: anyone who can open WhatsOn can change its settings and control your TVs, so keep it on your home network. Host networking lets it reach TVs on your network.
Container.Requirement: A Plex or Jellyfin server, and a Google TV or Android TV device with Plezy installed.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, TV pairings and saved keys. Protect this folder like a password file.

Config.Name: Allowed host names
Config.Description: Names you open WhatsOn by, separated by commas. Only needed for a DNS name or a reverse proxy: IP addresses and localhost always work.

Config.Name: Plex address
Config.Description: Optional. Used only when nothing is saved in Settings → Server → Plex, which is the easier way to connect.

Config.Name: Plex token
Config.Description: Optional. Goes with the Plex address above.
